description: This Java class 'ReconnectActor' manages automatic reconnection logic for communication channels within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It schedules periodic reconnect attempts, handles connection status responses, and interacts with other actors and components to maintain connection persistence and recovery.

classes.name: ReconnectActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for managing automatic reconnection logic by scheduling reconnect attempts, handling various connection status responses, and coordinating with other actors to maintain persistent connectivity within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating a ReconnectActor with a MongoReadJournal dependency.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating a ReconnectActor with a supplier of persistence id sources.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes the actor and schedules the periodic reconnect check when the actor starts.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cancels scheduled tasks when the actor stops.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for the actor, processing connection status responses, exceptions, and control messages to manage reconnect cycles.

methods.name: handleStartReconnect
methods.description: Begins a new reconnect cycle, throttling the requests according to configuration, and initiating reconnection attempts.

methods.name: handleEndReconnect
methods.description: Marks the end of a reconnect cycle, resetting the reconnect in-progress flag.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Sends a retrieve status command for the specified connection based on its persistence ID.

methods.name: toCorrelationId
methods.description: Generates a correlation ID string for a given connection ID.

methods.name: toConnectionId
methods.description: Parses a correlation ID string to extract the corresponding ConnectionId, if possible.

methods.name: getReconnectConfig
methods.description: Fetches the reconnect configuration from the actor context's system settings.
